mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENTS (PRODUCT_ID, WRITER_NO, CONTENT) VALUES (#{productId}, #{writerNo}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_ID, C.PRODUCT_ID, C.WRITER_NO, C.CONTENT, C.IS_DELETED, C.CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT_STR, case when U.IS_DELETED = 1 then '탈퇴한 회원' else U.NICKNAME end as WRITER_NICKNAME FROM COMMENTS C LEFT JOIN USERS U ON C.WRITER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE C.COMMENT_ID = #{commentId}

SELECT C.COMMENT_ID, C.PRODUCT_ID, C.WRITER_NO, C.CONTENT, C.IS_DELETED, C.CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT_STR, C.IS_DELETED, case when U.IS_DELETED = 1 then '탈퇴한 회원' else U.NICKNAME end as WRITER_NICKNAME FROM COMMENTS C LEFT JOIN USERS U ON C.WRITER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE C.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY C.COMMENT_ID ASC
